mapper.update: UPDATE document_delivery SET provider_envelope_id = #{providerEnvelopeId} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM document_delivery_recipient WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE document_delivery_recipient SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 'viewed' ELSE status END, first_viewed_at = COALESCE(first_viewed_at, #{viewedAt}) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('pending', 'viewed')

UPDATE document_delivery_recipient SET status = 'completed', decided_at = #{decidedAt}, token_hash = NULL, token_expires_at = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('pending', 'viewed')
